items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP object injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a Magento extension. This flaw, rated 9.8 CVSS, allows remote code execution via a crafted CacheWarmer cookie without authentication.

items.title: Security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin fixes 15 CVEs in Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source, including critical Stored XSS and Path Traversal issues. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution and arbitrary file system write.

items.title: Stored XSS vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical Stored Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) in Adobe Commerce, addressed in APSB26-49, could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Path Traversal vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical Path Traversal vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) in Adobe Commerce, addressed in APSB26-49, could lead to arbitrary file system write.

items.title: Unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files. This vulnerability can lead to remote code execution (RCE) or account takeover, with attacks observed on a high percentage of stores.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical security bulletin addresses multiple vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, and compromise store data.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability, part of APSB26-05, allows attackers to execute code remotely, potentially leading to full system takeover.

items.title: Improper Access Control in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical improper access control vulnerability, part of APSB26-05, allows bypassing security filters to access restricted information, resulting in data leaks.

items.title: Stored XSS in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical Stored XSS vulnerability, part of APSB26-05, enables malicious scripts to escalate user privileges, potentially leading to admin hijacking.
